notes: AEAT Manual practico IVA 2024, Capitulo 9 'La declaracion-resumen anual. Modelo 390' (paginas 292-294), supuesto practico del senor 'X' (fabricacion de aparatos electrodomesticos, epigrafe IAE 345.1), liquidacion del primer trimestre de 2024. The manual states its own subtotals verbatim in the 'Liquidacion primer trimestre' solucion: 'TOTAL CUOTA DEVENGADA: 23.088 euros' (pag. 293), 'TOTAL A DEDUCIR: 16.800 euros' (pag. 294), 'Diferencia: 6.288 euros', 'Cuota a compensar de periodos anteriores: 3.000 euros, de las que aplicamos a este trimestre 3.000 euros' and 'Diferencia a ingresar: 3.288 euros' (pag. 294). The devengado total is cross-validated across all four quarters of the SAME worked example, each of which explicitly sums its own 'Recargo de equivalencia' line into its printed 'TOTAL CUOTA DEVENGADA' (1T: 17.430+1.248+4.410=23.088; 2T: 19.110+4.410+624-2.520=21.624; 3T: 19.782-1.260+1.248+2.520=22.290; 4T: 21.420-630+624=21.414), confirming casilla 27 includes the recargo de equivalencia cuota tiers (casillas 18/21/24, LIVA art. 161) per the official Orden EHA/3786/2008 casilla-27 instructions. Every raw devengado/deducible line item feeding the scenario is quoted from the manual's own per-operation breakdown (pag. 292-293): ventas interiores 55.000(op7)+24.000(op9)+servicios 4.000(op8) at 21pct = 17.430; recargo de equivalencia on op9's 24.000 at 5.2pct = 1.248; adquisiciones intracomunitarias 18.000(op2)+3.000(op4) at 21pct = 4.410 (devengado AND deducible, self-assessed reverse charge); cuotas soportadas interiores 36.000(op1)+6.000(op3)+5.000(op5) at 21pct = 9.870; cuotas satisfechas en importaciones 12.000(op6) at 21pct = 2.520. Casilla 27 (Total cuota devengada), casilla 45 (Total a deducir), casilla 69 (iva.resultado, 'Resultado de la autoliquidacion') and casilla 71 (Resultado final) are each independently reproduced by the registry's own ledger-aggregation + resultado-chain formulas from these raw quoted line items (see test_m303_2024_regimen_general_manual_worked_example.py); none of 23.088/16.800/3.288 is copied from a hand-run of the registry formula under test.
